remarks: Bright, updated top-floor condo in St. Mary’s Square, ideally located in the heart of Allentown. This two-bedroom residence offers an open, light-filled layout with expansive windows, fresh paint and new flooring throughout. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, modern finishes and an adjoining dining area. Additional conveniences include central air, a key-access elevator, assigned off-street parking, private storage and common laundry facilities. Enjoy the privacy of having no neighbors above you and exceptional walkability to restaurants, theaters, galleries, downtown and the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus. The monthly association fee includes water, sewer, trash removal, snow removal, common-area and exterior maintenance, insurance and reserve funding. Cats and dogs are permitted with size restrictions. Move-in ready and offering comfortable, low-maintenance city living.
